chunks: The venerable Shaykh Abu Ja'far Muhammad ibn Ali ibn al-Husayn ibn Musa ibn Babawayh al-Qummi narrated to us. He said: Ja'far ibn Ali ibn al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Abdullah ibn al-Mughira al-Kufi narrated to us. He said: My grandfather al-Hasan ibn Ali narrated to us from his grandfather Abdullah ibn al-Mughira, from Isma'il ibn Abi Ziyad, from al-Sadiq Ja'far ibn Muhammad, from his father, from his forefathers (peace be upon them). He said: The Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and his family) said to his companions:

Shall I not tell you something, that if you do it, Satan would be as far from you as the East is from the West? They said: Of course. He said: Fasting blackens his face, charity breaks his back, loving for the sake of Allah and supporting one another in righteous deeds cut his tail, and seeking forgiveness cuts his artery. Everything has a purifier, and the purifier of the bodies is fasting.

key_terms.الاستغفار: Seeking forgiveness (Istighfar) — repentance that severs Satan's power at its source
key_terms.الشيطان: Satan (Shaytan) — the devil who tempts humans away from righteousness
key_terms.الصوم: Fasting — particularly Ramadan fasting, presented as the purification of the body
key_terms.زكاة الأبدان: Purification of the bodies — fasting serves as spiritual purification just as zakat purifies wealth

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet Muhammad say about the spiritual practices that repel Satan and purify the body?
ai.summary: In this hadith from the Fifteenth Assembly of al-Amali, held during the eighth of Ramadan 367 AH, the Prophet Muhammad addresses his companions with a powerful teaching on combating Satan. He presents five spiritual practices — fasting, charity, loving for Allah's sake, mutual support in righteousness, and seeking forgiveness — using vivid physical metaphors to describe how each one cripples Satan. The hadith concludes with the famous principle that fasting is the zakat (purification) of the body.

en.bilal-muhammad: Abu Ja`far Muhammad b. Ali b. al-Husayn b. Musa b. Babuwayh al-Qummi narrated to us. He said: Ja`far b. `Ali b. al-Hasan b. `Ali b. `Abdullah b. al-Mughira al-Kufi narrated to us. He said: My grandfather al-Hasan b. `Ali narrated to us from his grandfather Abdullah b. al-Mughira from Isma`il b. Abi Ziyad from al-Sadiq Ja`far b. Muhammad from his father from his forefathers (as). He said: The Messenger of Allah (s) said to his companions:

Should I not tell you something, that if you do it, Satan would be as far away from you as the East is from the West? They said: Of course. He said: Fasting blackens his face, charity breaks his back, loving for the sake of Allah and putting an effort into performing righteous deeds cuts his tail, and repentance cuts his artery. Everything has a purifier, and the purifier of the bodies is fasting.
